settings.heading: Delivery & returns
settings.content:
Every piece is made to order after you buy it. Estimated delivery is 5–7 business days. Shipping options and prices for your address are shown at checkout.

You can return unworn items within 14 days of delivery, and we provide a free return label. Read the full shipping policy and refund policy, or contact us.
